title: Ganbare Goemon 3 - Shishi Juurokubee no Karakuri Manjigatame
aliases: Ganbare Goemon 3: Shishi Juurokubee no Karakuri Manjigatame
description: The third Super Famicom game to feature Goemon, Ebisumaru and their friends. This game would break away from the linear stages of the earlier games and provide a larger interconnected world like those found in the N64 games.
